summary: Thermeleon is thermeleon's passive Heat Battery sustainably heats and cools high-tech greenhouses, charged by the existing excess heat, founded in 2020. Type: startup / scale-up. About 12 employees (LinkedIn page). Not found in the IND sponsor register. 100% of its 2 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.

culture.text: A 12-person company founded in 2020, with staff mostly from TU Delft studying mechanical engineering or engineering physics.
It says it is always looking for motivated interns in R&D and operations.

open.text: It is not an IND recognised sponsor.

worth_knowing.text: Its heat battery stores excess greenhouse heat to heat and cool, cutting gas costs and CO2 emissions.
